title: "Baltic Cod Predation on Sprat and Herring"
subtitle: "Spatial analysis using sdmTMB — Baltic Sea 2014–2021"
---

## Overview

This site presents the results of a delta-gamma spatial model of Atlantic cod
(*Gadus morhua*) predation on sprat (*Sprattus sprattus*) and herring
(*Clupea harengus*) in the Baltic Sea.

**Data:** ICES Stomach Content Database (EcoRegion 95, CC-BY 4.0)
**Method:** sdmTMB spatial delta-gamma model (Anderson et al. 2025)
**Period:** 2014–2021 (BITS/BIAS surveys, n = 4,092 cod stomachs)
